text: This Part provides for an assisted filing service to enable a person proposing to make an application under Part 4 of the Act to request: (a) a preliminary assessment from the Registrar concerning the likelihood of the application for the proposed trade mark being successful under Part 4 of the Act; and (b) information concerning the requirements for registration under Part 4 of the Act.
title: Purpose of Part

units.text: This Part provides for an assisted filing service to enable a person proposing to make an application under Part 4 of the Act to request:
(a) a preliminary assessment from the Registrar concerning the likelihood of the application for the proposed trade mark being successful under Part 4 of the Act; and
(b) information concerning the requirements for registration under Part 4 of the Act.
